text: In 1944 Francoist Spain, ten-year-old Ofelia travels with her pregnant, ailing mother to meet her new stepfather, Captain Vidal, who [tortures and kills to crush the Maquis|wrong|war and atrocity]. A stick insect turns into a fairy and leads her into an ancient stone labyrinth, where a faun hails her as [a lost princess of the underworld|origin|from another world] and sets her three tasks. One brings her to the lair of the Pale Man, [a monster that eats children|threat|monsters and creatures], where she has been warned [never to eat anything|trigger|breaking a rule].
